en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI leads The Game Awards 2026 nominations

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI leads The Game Awards 2026 with eight nominations
entries.summary: The Game Awards 2026 nominees are set. Grand Theft Auto VI leads with eight nominations, while Resident Evil Requiem and Control Resonant have six each and Phantom Blade Zero has five. The ceremony is scheduled for December 11 Beijing time.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON, Famitsu, and Denfaminicogamer reports independently agree on the nomination results. Denfaminicogamer also identifies the official nominations program and ceremony time.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 01:15 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window. The ceremony is scheduled for 09:30 Beijing time on December 11.

entries.headline: Xbox details its late-November Game Pass lineup, including The Outlast Trials
entries.summary: Xbox announced the next Game Pass wave, naming Hela: of Mice & Magic, The Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, and additional games.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire page directly lists the incoming lineup. Dates and membership tiers not fully visible in the packet snapshot are not added.
entries.timeNote: Published at 01:00 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: RPG Maker U2U launches January 28, 2027
entries.summary: Gotcha Gotcha Games will release RPG Maker U2U on January 28, 2027. The P2D Map Editor demo on Steam will remain available until launch, and demo data can carry into the full version.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer reports independently confirm the date and demo extension; Denfaminicogamer reproduces the publisher announcement in detail.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer published at 13:34 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed window. Launch is set for January 28, 2027.

entries.headline: Western RPG Six Bullets is built around dice rolls and a six-round limit
entries.summary: 2d6 Software announced Six Bullets for PC via Steam. Inspired by Disco Elysium, the western RPG centers actions on dice rolls and makes players manage only six bullets in combat.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report attributes the announcement to 2d6 Software and confirms the platform and core mechanics. No unannounced launch date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 15:53 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed window; no release date has been announced.

entries.headline: UK schools prepare for possible absences around Grand Theft Auto VI launch day
entries.summary: IGN reports that several UK schools warned parents about attendance ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI’s launch. Some also used pupil-proposed incentives, including gift-card drawings, to discourage absences.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report compiles public school notices and directly quotes a principal on the student-led incentive. Individual social posts are not generalized beyond the reported schools.
entries.timeNote: Published at 21:32 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed window; the game is scheduled for November 19.

entries.headline: Momotaro Dentetsu 2 releases a Nintendo Switch 2 demo
entries.summary: KONAMI released a Nintendo Switch 2 demo for Momotaro Dentetsu 2. Players can choose the East Japan or West Japan map and play the opening of a three-year match with up to four players.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report attributes the release to KONAMI and confirms the demo, platform, maps, and player count.
entries.timeNote: Published at 12:03 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed window; the demo launched the same day.

entries.headline: UK tribunal dismisses a $2.6 billion lawsuit over PlayStation Store pricing
entries.summary: VGC reports that London’s Competition Appeal Tribunal dismissed a UK class action over PlayStation Store pricing. The claim argued that PlayStation’s 30% cut raised prices and sought $2.6 billion in damages.
entries.verification: The opened VGC report identifies the parties, tribunal, requested damages, and dismissal, and credits The Game Business for the ruling report. No case number or ruling date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published at 00:08 Beijing time on November 18, inside the fixed window; the packet does not provide the precise ruling date.

entries.headline: Splatoon Raiders releases a Nintendo Switch 2 demo
entries.summary: Nintendo released a Nintendo Switch 2 demo for Splatoon Raiders. It includes six gadgets, three dungeons, and a sample of the salmon-fighting Treasure Hunt mode.
entries.verification: The opened Famitsu and Denfaminicogamer reports both embed and relay Nintendo’s official post. Denfaminicogamer supplies the November 17 timestamp and specific demo scope.
entries.timeNote: Denfaminicogamer published at 11:14 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed window; Famitsu has no precise timestamp.
